no_adcom_quote.quote: Clinical Review of NDA Prior Approval Supplement

summary: No advisory committee meeting is referenced in any FDA document available in paperclip for NDA022119 (Ammonia N 13). The only review package present is the S-001 labeling-correction supplement, whose Medical Review, Labeling Review, and teleconference minutes concern purely technical corrections to the gamma-ray constant and the lead-shielding attenuation table; the 'FDA panel' it mentions is the review-team teleconference of December 15, 2010, not an advisory committee. The original (Orig1s000) approval review package is not in paperclip, so no AdComm could be documented from the available sources; none of the four available documents mention an advisory committee, vote, or committee recommendation.
